entry.name: extraItems
entry.label: All plasmoid items that are explicitly enabled in the systray. It's a comma-separated string list of plasmoid plugin ids.

entry.name: disabledStatusNotifiers
entry.label: All StatusNotifier items that shouldn't be visible at all. It's a comma-separated string list of StatusNotifier ids.

entry.name: hiddenItems
entry.label: All items that are hidden, forced always in the popup. It's a comma-separated string list of unique identifiers that are either plasmoid plugin ids or StatusNotifier ids.

entry.name: shownItems
entry.label: All items that are shown. It's a comma-separated string list of unique identifiers that are either plasmoid plugin ids or StatusNotifier ids.

entry.name: showAllItems
entry.label: If true, all systray entries will be always in the main area, outside the popup.

entry.name: autoSort
entry.label: If true, tray icons are ordered automatically (by category, then name). If false (default), they follow itemOrder, which the user sets by dragging icons.

entry.name: itemOrder
entry.label: User-defined order of tray icons (item ids), used when autoSort is false. Icons not listed come last.

entry.name: reverseIconOrder
entry.label: Whether to reverse the order of icons in the panel

entry.name: scaleIconsToFit
entry.label: Whether to automatically scale System Tray icons to fit the available thickness of the panel. If false, tray icons use the size set by iconSize.

entry.name: iconSize
entry.label: Size in pixels of System Tray icons in the panel (when not scaling to fit) and in the hidden-items popup

entry.name: expanderOnLeft
entry.label: Whether the hidden-items expander arrow sits at the leading end of the tray, before the icons (Windows style). If false, it sits between the icons and the system cluster.

entry.name: popupColumns
entry.label: Maximum number of icons per row in the hidden-items popup

entry.name: iconSpacing
entry.label: spacing between icons, determined by this number multiplied by Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Whether the popup should remain open when another window is activated

entry.name: scale
entry.label: Scale percentage for the action panel and flyouts

entry.name: quickSettingsOrder
entry.label: Canonical ordering of the Action Panel's Quick Settings tiles, as an ordered list of stable tile identifiers. Drag-reordering the tiles in the Action Panel updates this. Unknown/duplicate identifiers are dropped and any missing known identifiers are appended automatically.
